sections.title: Business & location
fields: Individual, proprietorship, partnership or company. Business name, owner/contact, phone and email are reused from your partner profile.
Retailer, wholesaler, manufacturer or distributor; list all applicable roles.
Completed years; zero is allowed for a new business.
Include street, city, state and PIN code. Refer to your profile address if unchanged.
Link to the store or warehouse, not a customer's location.
Include weekly holidays and collection hours.
State available options, collection instructions and own/third-party delivery arrangements.

sections.title: Delivery & order limits
fields: List delivery areas or enter Pickup/in-store only.
Enter zero if there is no minimum value.
State the quantity and unit, or No minimum.
State order cutoff, delivery slots and estimated fulfilment time; enter Not applicable for delivery if unavailable.
State charges, free-delivery thresholds and any exceptions.

sections.title: Products & pricing
fields: Describe categories and brands. Maintain individual product names, descriptions, photos, prices and stock quantities in the catalogue.
Examples: bottle, can, packet, litre, piece, carton; include available sizes.
Retail, bulk pricing and additional charges
Describe retail/wholesale availability, quantity discounts, packaging charges and tax treatment.
Explain stock-update frequency and how customers approve substitutions and price changes.

sections.title: Quality, storage & safety
fields: Describe supplier checks, purchase records and manufacturer/distributor traceability.
Explain checks where relevant and isolation of damaged, expired or recalled products.
Describe suitable storage, separation of incompatible products and precautions against contamination.
Describe containment, sale prevention, reporting, customer notification and appropriate disposal/return arrangements.
Explain leak prevention, secure packaging and relevant handling precautions.
Describe how customers receive directions, warnings and appropriate product safety information.

sections.title: Registration & evidence
fields: List business/trade and relevant product permissions for your role and location. State Not applicable with reasons where appropriate; retailers should not provide a manufacturing licence merely for selling packaged products.
Provide an expiry date where applicable. List other validity dates in the evidence summary.

Identify relevant labels, catalogue, storage photographs, brand/distributor authorisation or safety data sheets. Water suppliers should include applicable food registration, reports and certification evidence. Reuse profile documents and tax details.

sections.title: Orders & customer policies
fields: Explain confirmation, out-of-stock handling and customer-approved substitutions.
Describe cancellation cutoffs, failed delivery, return eligibility and refund timelines without excluding applicable customer rights.
Explain wrong, damaged, leaking, expired or missing-product complaints, safety escalation, reasonable evidence and replacement/refund remedies.
State manufacturer warranty coverage, exclusions and claim steps only for eligible products; otherwise enter Not applicable.

Cleaning Products: Describe types and intended uses, household/professional ranges, chemical/refill products, dilution/use instructions, hazard warnings and applicable safety data sheets.
Personal Care Products: Describe categories/brands, manufacturer/importer details, sealed-pack practices, ingredients, directions, warnings, batch/expiry checks, evidence for special claims and opened/sealed return conditions.
Drinking Water Supplier: List brands, bottles/cans/jars or bulk supply, container sizes, daily capacity, recurring plans, pause/skip/cancellation terms and container deposit/return/refund/cleaning arrangements.
Household Supplies: Describe brands, categories, materials, sizes, disposable/reusable options, bulk supply and installation/assembly if offered.

Manufacturer: Describe source, treatment, production capacity, relevant permissions, quality-testing arrangements, report dates and applicable certification evidence.
Packaged-water distributor: Identify brands/manufacturers, applicable distributor permissions, supplier invoices, batch/expiry checks, storage and supplier quality/certification evidence. Do not provide a manufacturing licence solely for distribution.
Bulk / tanker supplier: Describe source, relevant permissions, water-quality testing/report dates, tanker capacity, cleaning/disinfection and hygienic transport controls.

policies: Delivery, cancellation, returns and refunds policy
